scope: Grade 6 Practice / Written / Readiness re-rank after Learn+Micro closure

principles.practice: Practice Room is shared topic/skill practice, not a second KNTT curriculum. Topic-level evidence may be pedagogically sufficient even when it does not prove exact lesson placement.
principles.written: Written placement must reflect true curriculum placement; prerequisite skill overlap must not create false KNTT placement.
principles.readiness: Only controlled structured assessment counts. Formative or written evidence must not be promoted into Readiness.

practice_rerank.rationale: All 31 Grade-6 rows already have topic-level Practice evidence; statuses describe evidence granularity rather than a requirement for a duplicate lesson-specific bank.
practice_rerank.protected_decision: Do not build a second KNTT Practice bank merely to turn topic-level evidence into lesson-specific evidence. Revisit only when learner evidence or a reviewed curriculum gap justifies it.

true_placement_candidates.reason: The task is an UCLN application; prime-factorization is supporting method/prerequisite, not the curriculum placement.
The task is a percentage discount problem; decimal arithmetic is supporting computation, not Bài 28-29 placement.
The task directly assesses experimental probability and interpretation.

false_positive_row_matches.reason: Prime factorization is used to compute UCLN but the exercise's curriculum purpose is UCLN application.
Decimal arithmetic is prerequisite/supporting computation; the curriculum purpose is percentage.

written_rerank.authoring_decision: Do not author new Written items yet. First reconcile true KNTT placements for the three already reviewed canonical exercises.

academic_review_candidate.reason: The existing readiness assessment contains four explicit Grade-6 items, all on experimental probability.

corrected_false_pending.reason: The current Grade-6 readiness items are all tagged xac-suat-thuc-nghiem and do not directly assess Bài 42 event/outcome content.

readiness_rerank.authoring_decision: Do not mass-author Readiness checks. Review the existing Bài 43 candidate first; keep all other unsupported rows explicitly unverified.

next_gate.release_boundary: Academic review only; no deploy authorization.
